name: Food Log

meta.description: Log what the user ate, following the food-logging constitution: structured items and portions only, validated and checked against USDA FoodData Central before anything is saved. Entries go to the user's food inbox; the nightly health ingest re-validates them and looks up nutrients in USDA FoodData Central. The model never estimates calories. Entries are never edited: corrections are new entries that supersede old ones.
